findings.label: aud not validated
findings.detail: aud is emitted in the token payload via getJWTCustomClaims() but is absent from required_claims in config/jwt.php. tymon never enforces it, so any token with a wrong or missing audience is accepted. Add 'aud' to the required_claims array.

findings.label: Cookie double-encryption
findings.detail: config/jwt.php sets decrypt_cookies: false but EncryptCookies has no $except entries for access_token or refresh_token. Laravel encrypts the cookie; tymon reads the ciphertext as a JWT and fails with TokenInvalidException. Add both cookie names to EncryptCookies::$except, or set decrypt_cookies: true.

findings.label: Hardcoded expires_in: 3600
findings.detail: issueTokenPair() always returns expires_in: 3600 regardless of JWT_TTL. If JWT_TTL is changed, clients receive wrong lifetime information. Replace with config('jwt.ttl') * 60.

findings.label: Inactive-account status code
findings.detail: Both JwtAuthenticate and JwtAuthController::login() return 401 for is_active = false. 403 is the correct semantic (identity confirmed, access denied). Update both paths.

findings.label: No rate limiting on auth endpoints
findings.detail: /api/auth/login and /api/auth/refresh have no throttle middleware. Apply throttle:5,1 as a minimum to prevent credential enumeration and refresh token replay attacks.

findings.label: Docs package version mismatch
findings.detail: docs/jwt-security.md references tymon/jwt-auth ^2.3 but composer.json targets ^2.1. Update the docs header to match.
